checks.requirement: T1: snapshot counts, types, arities, span, growth, quality
checks.detail: All four snapshots export the required distributions, spans and changes.

checks.requirement: T1: raw guide versus visible edges
checks.detail: Raw 405/589/1063/1429 versus consistent 374/526/983/1429; article/member visibility explains the differences.

checks.requirement: T2 / Deliverable 0: objective, tradeoff, guarantees, complexity, alternatives
checks.detail: Formal objective and native/pairwise alternative; tested construction guarantees distinguished from empirical quality.

checks.requirement: Literature: four verified complementary papers
checks.detail: Primary-source bibliography verification recorded; spectral hypergraphs, hierarchy, coarsening and evolution covered.

checks.requirement: P1/P2: laminar exclusive covering partitions and budgets
checks.detail: 25 hierarchies validate; tests reject overlap, empty clusters and invalid parents.

checks.requirement: P3: semantic/structural tradeoff
checks.detail: Five measured variants and original sensitivity; empirical usefulness is not guaranteed.

checks.requirement: T3/P5: temporal objective, IDs and events
checks.detail: Construction-time VI test, persistent IDs, and all six event types; measured stability separately.

checks.requirement: T4/P4: native collapse
checks.detail: m=n, partial and 3-endpoint cases preserve multiplicity/provenance; spy test proves coarse graph is next-level input; loss documented.

checks.requirement: T5: automatic labels, exact visible inputs, glosses
checks.detail: Every exported node has labels; all non-singletons have v2 overlays and complete generation inputs; split/cutoff audited.

checks.requirement: T6 coherence: independent model, nulls, singleton treatment
checks.detail: MiniLM construction versus BGE evaluation; exact-size/type nulls; singleton exclusions and descriptive p-values.

checks.requirement: T6 stability: five 10% edge-removal rebuilds and real transitions
checks.detail: Five deterministic removal sets asserted, all levels and approximate confidence intervals retained; unchanged artifact hashes verified.

checks.requirement: T6 labels: unchanged threshold, holdout, proxies and human audit
checks.detail: Automated paired held-out support evaluated at .50; human audit remains unfilled and scientific faithfulness unverified.

checks.requirement: T6 extrinsic: typed entities, flat/legacy/prototypes, cost and FP categories
checks.detail: Both cutoffs, five variants, five budgets; actual comparison traces; unmatched labels explicit; ground truth isolated from ranking.

checks.requirement: T6 supporting claims / Type B defensible ground truth
checks.detail: Actual question-to-entity-to-claim retrieval and source hits exist; no benchmark claims clear all prespecified alignment gates, so claim recall is null, never zero/imputed.

checks.requirement: P6: temporal honesty and label faithfulness
checks.detail: Visible inputs and no generation/holdout overlap verified; unversioned text, pretrained future knowledge and unverified expert faithfulness remain limitations.

checks.requirement: Variants and shipping decision
checks.detail: All five variants measured; temporal retained as browser on stability/coherence grounds, not certified QA.

checks.requirement: T7 deliverables and required hierarchy fields
checks.detail: Required files and all six hierarchy fields programmatically asserted; archive manifest checked by packaging step.

checks.requirement: Reproducibility: commands, seeds, dependencies, caches
checks.detail: README evaluation command executed; earlier clean isolated environment rebuild recorded. Pinned public model downloads are external prerequisites; derived embeddings are optional.

checks.requirement: Report: concise prose, verified/assumed, four more weeks
checks.detail: Main report separates measured results and limitations; detailed evidence in appendix. Markdown page count depends on renderer.

checks.requirement: AI usage: prompts, serial Ultralight consultations, automated checks
checks.detail: No human review or failed consultation is represented as a completed scientific audit.
